title: Match dedup collides all null-date matches on ts=0
evidence: src/loader.ts:316 deduplicateMatches keys on `${ts}|home|away` with ts=0 for any date===null; two genuinely distinct matches between the same teams whose dates fail to parse collapse to one and the later is dropped
suggestion: Include source + season (or rawDate) in the dedup key, or skip dedup for null-date rows

title: br_football competition label bypasses the substring competition filter
evidence: src/loader.ts:165 sets competition = row.tournament (arbitrary label), while queries filter via competitionMatches substring on 'Brasileirão' (src/queries.ts:86); br_football rows labeled e.g. 'Serie A' are excluded from a Brasileirão standings/goal query even though dedup treats them as Brasileirão
suggestion: Normalize tournament labels to the canonical competition set, or map br_football tournament values onto the same competition vocabulary

title: bestRecord/topScoringTeams recompute teamStats per team over all matches (O(teams×matches))
evidence: src/queries.ts:379 and src/queries.ts:407 call teamStats() once per distinct team, each rescanning ds.matches (~20k rows); on a full-dataset query this is quadratic
suggestion: Single-pass accumulate per-team records in one loop instead of calling teamStats per team
